currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The shop's currency: an ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, PKR …). Every price is in it.

productUrl.title: Product page address
productUrl.description: Where a product's page is on your website: a path with {slug} (or {id}), for example /products/{slug}.

categoryUrl.title: Category page address
categoryUrl.description: Where a category's page is on your website: a path with {slug}, for example /categories/{slug}.

mediaBaseUrl.title: Public address of your images
mediaBaseUrl.description: The public https address your storage or CDN serves files from (for example https://cdn.shop.com). Empty: images are shown through short-lived signed links.
